scientific_limitations: The stationary joint density and renewal mixture were established previously and are not claimed as new.
Fixed finite \(N\geq3\) and fixed strictly positive directional levels; no simultaneous large-N/far-tail limit.
Stationary cross-covariance is asserted only for \(N\geq5\).
Further publication-priority review could uncover a broader scale-mixture tail theorem.
title: Multivariate Pareto excursions and a Gamma reset-age law in a first-passage-resetting Brownian gas
